text: His roommate kirpal Singh was calling the receptionist and she complained. Both were banned
Gupte was banned because he did not stop him
Yes we were discussing the greatest Indian bowler in Tests, and after everyone had shared their picks KV talked about Subhash Gupte
Cricket KViz- Sal, Shashank and I were there

I was typing the following message.
Sometimes the knowledge you guys have I wonder GK  (general knowledge) or JK (Janaani knowledge)
And as I typed I paid attention to the word Janani (which until now I used to think was gossip monger) and thought maybe the word means mother. And that is in fact the origin of the word which in recent colloquial usage is now used to mean gossiping aunty apparently
Ety, probably, janani, as in janm dene wali
What an unfortunate usage it has been adopted for
In Bengali it is Janoni meaning mother
My Bengali friend invited me for a gourmet meal. Realised later he was inviting me home
